root_cause: The Notion company-decision projection already used bounded row concurrency, but each update still performed a separate fingerprint query followed by a page update. Normal update-heavy syncs therefore paid roughly two Notion round trips per decision, and retry behavior was decentralized.
prevention_rule: Batch-resolve existing fingerprints before row fan-out, reuse resolved page ids for direct idempotent updates, preserve query-before-create for missing rows, and centralize bounded Retry-After-aware retries for transient Notion throttling/service pressure.
evidence: Existing sync concurrency is preserved and capped at six.
Fingerprint prefetch batches are capped at 50 and prefetch concurrency at three.
Known existing pages bypass the per-row lookup; missing pages retain the original query-before-create path.
429/503/529 responses retry centrally with Retry-After or bounded exponential backoff.
